parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to return. Page numbers start from 1.

parameters.name: FirmwareId
parameters.description:
The ID of the update package. This is the unique identifier of the update package.

The FirmwareId is one of the parameters returned when you call [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) to create an update package. You can also call [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) to view the ID from the response parameters.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or the </ph></props>ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of update packages to display per page in the response. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
